decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing Greasefang Parhelion's abilities to create a powerful combo that can overwhelm the opponent. It includes cards that provide card advantage and disruption such as Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck also includes support creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Overlord of the Balemurk to help facilitate the combo. With powerful finishers like Parhelion II and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship, the deck aims to quickly close out the game once the combo is assembled.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through removal and countermagic while utilizing card advantage and powerful planeswalkers to outvalue the opponent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with a combination of removal spells like Portable Hole and Supreme Verdict, backed up by counterspells like Dovin's Veto. The deck also includes card draw spells like Memory Deluge and March of Otherworldly Light to ensure it has the resources to stay ahead. Teferi, Hero of Dominaria is a key threat that can provide card advantage and control the board.

The deck focuses on aggressively using cards that allow for direct damage, disruption, and efficient creature removal. It utilizes a mix of powerful creatures, removal spells, and card advantage to maintain pressure on the opponent and quickly close out games. The inclusion of a companion adds an additional layer of consistency and versatility to the deck's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of fast creatures and disruptive spells, while also providing some flexibility and resilience through its card choices.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and combat tricks to quickly deal damage to the opponent and control the board. By including Jegantha as a companion, the deck gains an additional source of mana ramp and a potential finisher. The inclusion of powerful cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Emberheart Challenger, and Kumano Faces Kakkazan allows for early pressure and explosive plays, while removal spells like Fatal Push and Reckless Rage help deal with threats. The deck aims to close out games quickly with a combination of creature beats and burn spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap spells and card draw to quickly fill the graveyard with instants and sorceries, enabling the Arclight Phoenix to be brought back from the graveyard multiple times in a single turn. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of flying Phoenixes while disrupting their game plan with countermagic and removal spells. The combination of aggressive creatures, efficient spells, and card advantage allows the deck to maintain tempo and pressure throughout the game, ultimately leading to a swift victory.

The key concept of this deck is focused on building a strong aggro strategy around the Human creature type. By utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Thalia's Lieutenant to pump up the team, along with cards like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Coppercoat Vanguard to apply pressure, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly with a swarm of efficient creatures. The inclusion of disruptive elements like Get Lost and Brutal Cathar also helps to disrupt opponents' plans and pave the way for a lethal assault. This deck is designed to be fast, aggressive, and relentless in its pursuit of victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and removal spells to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional utility and consistency to the deck. Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Voldaren Thrillseeker offer powerful threats, while cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize help control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes some unique cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Fear of Missing Out to provide additional reach and card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain it throughout the game.

The main concept of this UW Control deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage to disrupt the opponent's game plan. It focuses on stalling the game with board wipes like Supreme Verdict and March of Otherworldly Light, while generating card advantage with cards like Memory Deluge and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The deck utilizes creatures like The Wandering Emperor and Shark Typhoon for additional threats, along with utility lands like Castle Ardenvale and Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire for extra value. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through strategic control.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck in Pioneer 1 vs 1 is to disrupt the opponent's hand and resources while controlling the board with removal spells. The deck aims to generate value from the opponent's discarded cards through cards like Waste Not and Hostile Investigator. With cards like Liliana of the Veil and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, the deck can grind out advantages over time. The deck also has a few win conditions in the form of creatures like Foulmire Knight and Graveyard Trespasser. Overall, the deck seeks to outvalue and outcontrol the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish a board presence with Spirit creatures and disrupt the opponent's plans using counterspells and removal spells. The deck aims to play aggressively while also maintaining control over the game through tempo plays and resource denial. By efficiently using the deck's synergy between Spirit creatures and spells, the player can overwhelm the opponent and secure victory in a 1 vs 1 match. Emphasizing speed and disruption, this Azorius Tempo/Spirit Aggro deck provides a versatile and potent strategy for Pioneer gameplay.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and resources while using Enigmatic Incarnation to tutor for powerful creatures. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as an additional card advantage engine. The deck includes a mix of utility creatures, removal spells, and powerful threats such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines. By utilizing the deck's mana base and Enigmatic Incarnation, the player can quickly assemble a powerful board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy effectively.

This aggro Selesnya deck focuses on disrupting opponents' strategies with cards like Archon of Emeria and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, while putting pressure on the board with efficient creatures like Skyclave Apparition and Aven Interrupter. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of early aggression and disruptive elements, leveraging the synergy between creatures and spells like Collected Company. By combining efficient creatures with disruptive elements, the deck aims to maintain board presence and pressure opponents to make suboptimal plays.

The main focus of this deck revolves around quickly casting spells to discard Arclight Phoenix, allowing it to be brought back from the graveyard multiple times in a single turn to deal significant damage to the opponent. The deck includes key cards such as Lightning Axe, Fiery Impulse, and Treasure Cruise to help enable this strategy, while also providing card draw and disruption to the opponent through cards like Opt, Consider, and Spell Pierce. The inclusion of versatile threats like Brazen Borrower and Hall of Storm Giants adds additional pressure to the opponent while the lands and card draw effects help ensure a consistent stream of spells to trigger the phoenix's ability.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with low-cost creatures and mana accelerants, aiming to overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of threats. The deck includes disruptive elements like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria to hinder the opponent's game plan, while also having access to powerful cards like Collected Company and Skyclave Apparition for versatility and removal. The deck's mana base is optimized for smooth color access and efficient mana ramping, allowing it to consistently apply pressure and maintain board control throughout the game.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on overwhelming your opponent with fast, efficient creatures and burn spells. It utilizes cards like Burning-Tree Emissary and Monastery Swiftspear to quickly apply pressure, while Atarka's Command and Play with Fire provide reach and finisher potential. The deck aims to be proactive and aggressive, using efficient creatures and direct damage to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize. By combining creatures with burn spells, this deck aims to pressure the opponent from multiple angles and force them to react defensively.

This deck focuses on using the companions Keruga and Gyruda to generate card advantage and set up powerful combos. It includes a variety of creatures and lands to support these companions, as well as spells like Leyline Binding and Virtue of Persistence to control the board and protect your combo pieces. The deck aims to control the game early on, then ramp into big threats like Quintorius Kand and Spinewoods Armadillo to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.
